companies.source_text_excerpt:
DASH™ Rapid PCR System is a simple, affordable, point-of-care platform that performs sample-to-answer PCR in 15 minutes.

Nuclein DASH Rapid PCR System

Rapid PCR Made Simple™
Lab-Quality Results in 15 Minutes
Watch the demo
How to run a test
From testing to treating in 15 minutes
The point-of-care DASH Rapid PCR System and FDA-cleared, CLIA-waived DASH SARS-CoV-2 & Flu A/B Test deliver lab-quality results within a single patient visit
Simple
Intuitive, easy-to-operate user experience
Affordable
Low-cost solution enables PCR testing at the point of care
Rapid
Delivers results in 15 minutes, with only one minute of hands-on time
Accurate
Lab-quality results enhance confidence in treatment decisions
Cartridges are stored at room temperature
Wi-Fi and cloud connectivity enabled
Lab-quality PCR test results within minutes at the point of care
Designed to support a wide variety of sample types
Small instrument footprint (15”D x 11”H x 4”W)
Built to be multiplex-capable in a single cartridge
Want to know more about the
DASH Rapid PCR System?
Please submit your information in the
following form to be contacted by a
Nuclein representative with more details
about the DASH Rapid PCR System.
By submitting this form, I agree that the information I’ve provided above may be used by Nuclein, LLC to provide me with information, offers, and marketing materials for products and services. For more information about how we will use and disclose your information, please review our privacy policy .
What Our Customers Are Saying
{
Patients leave the clinic with a treatment plan tailored to lab-quality test results. It also makes the clinician consultation much more straightforward and frees up the staff. There is no need to call the patient back later.
Sometimes we have results before the provider even enters the patient’s room.
Laboratory Supervisor
Urgent Care Clinic
North Carolina
{
We have had an excellent experience with the Nuclein DASH instrument, customer support, and sales. We are able to rapidly test for three viruses with one swab, all while the patient is still in the office eliminating the need for patients to await a call for their results after they have left.
We love DASH!
Laboratory Supervisor
Pediatric Clinic
North Carolina
{
The DASH Rapid PCR System is by far the easiest, most intuitive unit to use thus far in my career. Where we used to frustratingly suffer from incomplete or inconclusive results, the DASH has performed flawlessly.
Integration into our workflow and processes has been effortless given the ease of use and minimal hands-on time needed to process a specimen. Support has been first class. Overall, well done!
Physician
Primary Care Clinic
Texas
